item.title: North Chicago (IL) FD Adds New Engine
item.description: The North Chicago (IL) Fire Department took delivery of a 2025 Sutphen engine, which has a 2,000-gallon-per-minute (gpm) pump and a 1,000-gallon tank. The post North Chicago (IL) FD Adds New Engine appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Hope (Canada) FD Welcomes New Tender to Fleet
item.description: The Hope (Canada) Fire Department's new tender has a 1,250-gpm pump and a 2,000-gallon water tank. The post Hope (Canada) FD Welcomes New Tender to Fleet appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Hilltown (PA) VFC Says Goodbye to Long-Serving Tanker
item.description: The Hilltown (PA) Volunteer Fire Company recently bid farewell to Tanker 61, which served the community for decades, as it was driven away by longtime member John Snyder. The post Hilltown (PA) VFC Says Goodbye to Long-Serving Tanker appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Engine Company Setup: Triple Layer, Minuteman, or Flat Load?
item.description: There always seems to be differing opinions on which hose load is best. It comes down to a debate between the triple layer, the minuteman, and flat loads. Which one is the best? item.title: NAFECO Appoints Brandon Oaks CEO and President
item.description: Brandon Oaks succeeds his late father, Jerrell Oaks, who founded NAFECO, a supplier of fire, law enforcement, emergency medical services (EMS), and industrial safety equipment and uniforms. The post NAFECO Appoints Brandon Oaks CEO and President appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Three PA Fire Companies Set to Merge. ‘Going to Help the Community a Lot’
item.description: Three Philipsburg-area fire companies are merging to enhance emergency coverage and funding access, addressing challenges of declining membership and rising costs. The consolidation awaits state approval. The post Three PA Fire Companies Set to Merge. ‘Going to Help the Community a Lot’ appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Fire Apparatus Struck Responding to Fire That Displaced 18 People in NJ
item.description: A Newark fire truck was disabled after being struck by a car while responding to a two-alarm fire that displaced 18 people. The cause of the fire is under investigation. The post Fire Apparatus Struck Responding to Fire That Displaced 18 People in NJ appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: MA FD Receives Safety Equipment Grant
item.description: The Amesbury Fire Department received a $24,060 grant from the Last Call Foundation to purchase 40 personal safety rope systems, addressing a significant equipment gap for firefighter safety. The post MA FD Receives Safety Equipment Grant appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.
